g.text: Upstream throughput, utilization and SFU fairness
4 or 8 SFUs · 2 STAs per SFU · 100 ms observation · T4-only input retains the configured T1 fixed profile
Points average available values across 3 matched seeds. Whiskers show the seed min–max.
Dashed horizontal lines mark the 2,500 Mb/s physical rate. Utilization uses actual transmission airtime. Jain axes can start above zero.
